question: Who amongst the following was appointed as Chairman of DRDO in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Satheesh Reddy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **G Satheesh Reddy** was appointed as the Chairman of DRDO in 2018.
 
• He succeeded **S Christopher** who completed his term in May 2018.
 
• G Satheesh Reddy is a renowned aerospace scientist and has been a part of several key projects in DRDO.
 
• His appointment was significant in continuing the momentum in defense research and development in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is an agency under the **Department of Defence Research and Development** in **Ministry of Defence**, Government of India.
 
• DRDO is charged with the military's research and development, headquartered in New Delhi, India.
 
• It was formed in **1958** by the merger of the Technical Development Establishment and the Directorate of Technical Development and Production with the Defence Science Organisation.
 
• DRDO's primary responsibility is to develop defense technologies covering various fields, including aeronautics, armaments, electronics, land combat engineering, life sciences, materials, missiles, and naval systems.
 
• Over the years, DRDO has grown multi-directionally in terms of the variety of subject disciplines, number of laboratories, achievements, and stature.
